results.substantiveAssertion: The type of mercury in vaccines – ethylmercury – is NOT harmful to us.
There have been no credible studies that link vaccination to chronic disease.
Vaccines are tested more than any other medicine you could give your kid.
The CDC manipulated data linking the MMR vaccine to autism.
The 1986 National Childhood Vaccine Injury Act removed all liability from drug companies for childhood vaccines.
The rise in chronic illnesses among children correlates with the increase in vaccine doses since the 1986 act.
Aluminum in vaccines is safe and occurs in lower amounts than in food.
Thimerosal is not harmful and has been removed from childhood vaccines.
The CDC has never safety tested the cumulative aluminum load received in multiple vaccine shots.
Vaccines are linked to an increase in Sudden Infant Death Syndrome (SIDS).
The CDC's narrative about vaccine safety is based on flawed or manipulated data.
